phase3_findings.description: render()'s operator-facing intro summary still defines REMOVED as 'tool absence with both controls run (REMOVED, presumptive)' — the pre-#1527 definition. This same PR changed REMOVED everywhere else (module docstring, compute_verdict comment, the [!NOTE] block) to mean a ScheduleWakeup denial recorded with NO registered tool_use attempt, and made both-controls-run explicitly no longer evidence of removal. The rendered summary line now misinforms the operator reading the verdict report. Non-machine-consumed prose: fix in place, do not pin.
Changeset body is a bare prose paragraph rather than the '-' bullet form the .changeset/README documents. PR-cited (#1937) and will consolidate fine; nit only.

## Review — PR #1937 (ScheduleWakeup probe verdict name-scope, issue #1527)

**Verdict: REJECT** (one Important finding, fixable in place)

### Scope
Branch delta (merge-base origin/main -> HEAD), 6 files, ~218 insertions. Diff profile: small_diff. Not engine-self-modifying (no skills/**, agents/**, lib/** non-test, prompt-extension, or CLAUDE.md touched — the diff is scripts/, lib/test/, .github/workflows/, docs/internal/, .changeset/). Prompt-surface edit-routing gate: NOT triggered (no trigger-glob path touched) — no finding.

### What the change does (assessed correct)
- scripts/schedulewakeup-probe-verdict.py: the ScheduleWakeup attempt predicate now keys on the recorded tool_use NAME (names_text) rather than substring-matching the input JSON, so a ToolSearch query naming ScheduleWakeup is no longer a false attempt. Ship verdicts DENIED/REMOVED now require a positive permission_denials record; presumptive absence (both controls run, no attempt, no denial) resolves INCONCLUSIVE. Branch ordering (note_top -> INCONCLUSIVE; denied+attempted -> DENIED; denied -> REMOVED; attempted -> AVAILABLE; else INCONCLUSIVE) is consistent with the docstring and every test fixture. Fail-open is in the safe direction (never ships a flag on weak/degraded evidence); note_top precedence keeps a partial-JSONL corruption off a shippable REMOVED. 'Always exits 0' contract holds (unreadable file, TOCTOU, unwritable GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY all handled).
- lib/test/modules/review-stall-backstop.sh: #415 swv arms updated RED-first for #1527; every changed/new verdict arm is exercised (ToolSearch-not-an-attempt, both-controls+no-signal -> INCONCLUSIVE, positive-denial-no-attempt -> REMOVED, DENIED precedence, partial-JSONL corruption, lower-cased name, input-less name). Mutation-guard coverage verified genuine against the pre-fix helper.
- matcher-probe.yml / DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md / implement-skill.md: the withdrawn 'MEASURED AVAILABLE' citation (runs 29140791165 / 29138117625) is corrected consistently to 'WITHDRAWN / awaiting re-measurement'; no stale AVAILABLE claim remains outside the new prose. Two new live-probe-only jobs (schedulewakeup-reinvoke-probe, schedulewakeup-disable-cron-probe) are correctly documented as having no suite coverage and carry no verdict/gating step.
- .changeset: patch bump, type Fixed.

### Findings
1. **Important** — scripts/schedulewakeup-probe-verdict.py:~199. render()'s intro summary still carries the pre-#1527 REMOVED definition ('tool absence with both controls run (REMOVED, presumptive)'), contradicting the shipped code and the rest of this same PR. Corroborated independently by code-reviewer, pr-test-analyzer, and the final-pass reviewer. Remedy: reword the summary line so REMOVED reads as 'a ScheduleWakeup denial with no registered attempt'. In-place prose fix; no pin.
2. **Suggestion** — .changeset body style (paragraph vs '-' bullets). Nit; consolidates fine.
